name: code_read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever the PUBLIC_URL environment variable isn't set, and that fallback is used to build the password reset link (and other email links) in this file. In production this env var is apparently missing or unset, so users get localhost links instead of the real site URL. Fix by ensuring PUBLIC_URL is set correctly in the production environment/config, and consider failing loudly (or using a safer default) when it's missing instead of silently falling back to localhost.

input.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and passwordResetEmail (along with rollupText and scheduledExportEmail) builds its links from that constant. This means that if PUBLIC_URL isn't configured in the production environment, password reset emails (and other emails) end up linking to localhost instead of the real site, which matches the reported bug.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set to the correct production URL in the deployment/environment configuration, and/or make the code fail loudly (e.g. throw or log an error at startup) when PUBLIC_URL is missing in a non-development environment, rather than silently falling back to localhost. This prevents a misconfiguration from silently shipping broken links in user-facing emails.
